scope: Actual rounded card geometry and shader source invariants. Does not rasterize shaders or replace browser visual review.

tests.name: All vertices, normals and UVs are finite
Indices are valid and triangles nondegenerate
All winding agrees with outward vertex normals
Artwork faces sit on actual opposite outer planes
Closed welded two-manifold with opposite edge incidence
One connected component, sphere topology, positive volume
Mesh stays inside former clearance envelope
No disconnected square corners outside rounded footprint
Artwork side selection follows geometric side, independent of view winding
Main and shadow silhouettes use geometry without fragment discard
